description.value: The Shed is a low-and-slow BBQ smokehouse and bar in downtown Kimberley, leaning into the Kootenay ethos of 'dirt-baggery' — a celebration of adventure and free time over busy-ness. The menu is a deep roster of smoked meats, tacos, loaded nachos, and sandwiches built for sharing, alongside local draught beer and cocktails. It operates entirely first-come-first-served with no reservations, making it a laid-back stop after a day on the trails.

address.value: 180 Deer Park Avenue, Kimberley, BC V1A 2J4

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully functional and confirms the business is open at 180 Deer Park Avenue, Kimberley, with phone (250) 427-0297. The contact page explicitly offers takeout ordering. The menu uses consistent legend symbols (* vegetarian, ** vegan, ✪ gluten-free) applied across many items, confirming dietary options. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or charging anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; (250) 427-0297 sourced from website only — contact_confirmed.phone set to null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible BBQ bar and restaurant in downtown Kimberley with a confirmed website, address, and phone number. Clearly open and relevant to touring cyclists seeking a meal.
enrichment_extras.notes: The website mentions that The Shed's hot sauce is also sold at 'Pedal & Tap', which appears to be a local cycling-related business — potentially a useful cross-reference for the directory.
